title: Ox Passion Fruity Gum Nic Salts E-Liquid 10ml
description: Fruity Gum by OX Passion is a nostalgic confectionery blend that's bursting with flavour. It combines a medley of ripe, juicy Mixed Fruits with a classic, sugary Bubblegum base, creating a sweet and playful vape that perfectly balances fruity notes with a candy-style finish. The OX Passion Nic Salt range is crafted by OXVA, a brand renowned for their high-performance vape kits. These e-liquids are formulated to deliver intense, concentrated flavour, making them an excellent choice for vapers who prioritise taste. With a 50% VG / 50% PG blend, this e-liquid is optimised for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping. It is designed to work flawlessly with low-wattage devices, particularly pod vape kits like the OXVA Xlim series, producing discreet vapour and exceptional flavour clarity. The nicotine salt formulation ensures a smooth throat hit and rapid nicotine satisfaction. OX Passion Nic Salts are available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg strengths, allowing you to tailor your vaping experience. This 10ml e-liquid is TPD-compliant and features a childproof cap and tamper-evident seal.
